summary: Strategy Inc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement (Supplement No. 1 to the STRK Stock Annex) covering an at-the-market program for up to $2.1 billion of its 8.00% Series A Perpetual Strike Preferred Stock (STRK), listed on Nasdaq. The supplement updates the annex to reflect an Amended and Restated Certificate of Designations filed October 29, 2026 in Delaware, effective January 1, 2027, approved at the October 28, 2026 special meeting, switching regular dividend payments from quarterly to each business day beginning January 4, 2027. Last reported STRK price was $67.85 on October 30, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown with a dividend-cadence amendment, not a special situation; watch for dilution and preferred dividend cash flow.
